judge_identity_note: Explicit research judge override; official rubrics and verifier code unchanged. Not claiming official leaderboard comparability to Kimi default.
task_order: round-robin: code, web, office, security; two work tasks each
heldout: initial and final fixed versions, fresh independent environments; scores never fed back
error_policy: Recoverable task/tool/candidate errors return to Agent; execution/official judge infrastructure/model transport/unknown usage stops, preserving all records without filling unresolved scores with zero.
network: Custom owned Docker attachment adapter: learner offline, verifier original public/no-network; exact per-trial CID only. No global Docker changes. No untrusted host socket access.
interpretation: Pilot self-evolution research, not a full benchmark ranking or independent causal proof. Preparation fixtures are not autonomous improvements. Current supervisor is not hot-replaced.
configuration_role: Recorded manifest of the fixed runner constants; selected task metadata supplies per-task limits. No model budget fields are enforced.
network_cleanup: Stopped containers retained; only exact trial-owned unused Docker networks released with inspect records to avoid address-pool exhaustion.
native_evaluation: Candidate code remains process-sandboxed. Owner-bound Bash runs in a separate offline same-image nonroot container with no mounts/scoring; no official project is shared. Missing capability or transport/unknown usage stops.
